items: Every morning, when my alarm clock rings (we often say goes off too) I wake up. Then I get up and have a shower and get dressed. I go downstairs and have breakfast. Then I go back to the bathroom and clean/brush my teeth. At the end of the day, at about 11.30, I go upstairs, get undressed and go to bed. I listen to the radio for a while, then I turn off the light (or turn the light off) and fall asleep.
